items.title: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page

content.body:
People who work at night ask for a darker theme.

## Acceptance Criteria
- A toggle in Settings switches between light and dark
- The choice is remembered after a reload
- Colour contrast meets WCAG AA in both themes
content.title: Add a dark mode toggle to the settings page

items.title: Search box loses focus after the first keystroke

content.body: Typing in the header search drops focus after one character. Seen in Firefox and Chrome.
content.title: Search box loses focus after the first keystroke

items.title: Rate limit responses need a Retry-After header

content.body:
Clients get a 429 with no hint about when to retry, so they hammer the endpoint.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Every 429 response includes Retry-After in seconds
- The value matches the limiter window
- Documented in the API reference
content.title: Rate limit responses need a Retry-After header

items.title: Keyboard shortcuts for the table view

content.body:
Power users want j and k to move between rows and enter to open one.

## Acceptance Criteria
- j and k move the selection
- Enter opens the selected row
- The shortcuts are listed in a help dialog
content.title: Keyboard shortcuts for the table view
